## About
Ali Sadikin Ma is an AI Generalist Expert based in Indonesia. He combines expertise in artificial intelligence, full-stack web development, and digital marketing to build innovative solutions. Champion of the Outskill AI Fellowship 2025 Demo Day, recognized for outstanding AI project implementation.

- Digital Marketing & SEO
